resolutions.answer: On the ten-probe set, render.md determines every exercised behavior and every determination agrees with render.py; undetermined_behaviors = []. The per-probe analysis in ea-analysis.md maps each probe to the governing spec clause (well-formed substitution incl. adjacency/repeats; missing name -> empty string; malformed brace forms '{{ name }}', '{{}}', '{{num1}}' literal; single-pass non-rescanning of inserted '{{w}}'; no other transformation) and gives an explicit exhaustiveness argument that no undetermined or divergent behavior exists on this probe set.

Not resolvable in this session: E-B's authorship condition (never accessed render.py nor any derived analysis) is already violated by this worker having read the package. A clean-room child bundle is proposed under child/ whose input manifest contains only package/artifacts/render.md; the root-executed create-child and child-return nodes will produce render_clean.py with admissible provenance.

The item-level comparison cannot exist before the Q2 clean-room artifact exists. A deterministic, judgment-free comparison rule over all ten probes is pre-committed in child/integration-plan.json for the root-executed verify-integration node; it yields the sorted list of divergent probe indices.

The verdict is a function of Q1 and Q3 under the E-C rule (DIVERGES iff the comparison shows a differing output on some probe, else REPRODUCES). Q1 is settled (undetermined_behaviors = []) but Q3 awaits integration, so result.json carries verdict = PENDING-INTEGRATION and divergent_probe_indices = PENDING-INTEGRATION; the E-C derivation is pre-committed in child/integration-plan.json.
